payload.artist_html: R. T. Müller, L. Roberto-da-Silva, O. L. Porcela Aurélio & L. Kerber
payload.credit_html: "The smallest tetrapod from the Middle Triassic of South America: a new procolophonoid parareptile from the Ladinian of Southern Brazil"
payload.description_html: Provenance of Sauropia macrorhinus. (a) Location and geological context of the Cortado site, Novo Cabrais, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Map was generated with GIMP version 2.8 (https://www.gimp.org/). (b) Aerial view of the Cortado site (photograph taken in June 2024). The white star marks the location of CAPPA/UFSM 0510. (c) Stratigraphic column of the Cortado site30 showing the level where CAPPA/UFSM 0510 (white star) was discovered. (d) General view of the Cortado site (taken in June 2024), indicating the spot where CAPPA/UFSM 0510 was discovered (white star).
